purpose: 투표 처형 연출용, 밧줄에 묶인 스킨별 단일 전신 스프라이트
postProcess: 생성 결과(1024x1535-1536)를 알파 8 이상 영역 + 여백 4px로 자르고, 가로·세로를 4의 배수로 맞춤(남는 칸은 좌우·위쪽 투명). 발끝이 이미지 아래 끝, 가로는 알파 영역 중앙. 피벗은 하단 중앙. width/height/pivot/alphaBounds/transparentPixels는 자른 뒤 값.
commonPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE transparent PNG full-body SD/chibi sprite for a Unity pirate social-deduction game's vote-elimination cutscene. Input Image 1 is the character identity reference sheet: use ONLY the full-body standing character in its TOP-LEFT cell; the other five poses are identity references, not output layout. Input Image 2 is a reference for the rope material, restrained pose, proportions, framing and painterly finish only; never copy its face or outfit. Produce ONE character, NOT a sheet. Preserve the identity, head/body ratio, face, colors, species, costume, headwear and identifying accessories of Image 1. Full body upright, frontal with a very slight three-quarter turn, centered, feet together and on one baseline. Thick tan ship rope wraps in many horizontal coils around the CLOTHED torso and upper arms pinned to the sides, waist, and wrists held together in front, with a clear front knot. Separate coils around both lower legs together. Neck, mouth and face unobstructed, rope below shoulders. Restrained serious or concerned expression suitable to this character. No handheld objects that would conflict with bound hands; preserve pouches/props attached to belt. Entire body visible, around 88% canvas height, 6% clear top and bottom padding; do not cut off feet, tail, hat, hair or fins. Match detailed painterly pirate-game 2D rendering and compact chibi proportions. Real transparent alpha background; no dark gradient, no scenery, no floor, no chair/post, no background shadow, no text, labels, frame or watermark, no duplicates. Fully clothed non-graphic cartoon game asset, no injury or gore.
promptComposition: 첫 스킨은 fullPrompt. 나머지 스킨은 commonPrompt + promptSuffix를 그대로 연결. referenceImages 순서대로 입력. transparent_background=true.

assets.fullPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one transparent PNG full-body sprite for a Unity pirate social-deduction game's vote-elimination cutscene. Image 1 is the character identity and rendering reference. Make one single bound version of THIS exact SD/chibi adult female pirate spy: identical large head / compact body proportions, black hood with red lining, dark braided hair, gold earrings, red scarf, black leather coat, belt, gold accessories and boots. Keep her face, costume, colors and detailed painterly 2D sprite finish. Standing upright, front-facing with a slight natural three-quarter turn like the reference, feet together and planted at the same ground level. Thick ordinary tan ship rope wraps tightly in many layered horizontal loops around the clothed chest, upper arms pinned to her sides, wrists and waist, with a clear knot at the front; a separate rope loop binds the lower legs together. Body and arms visibly restrained, face fully visible with a stern displeased expression. Rope stays below the shoulders, neck and mouth remain unobstructed. Full body including hat and both feet, centered, roughly 88 percent of canvas height, generous clear edge padding, no clipping. Genuine transparent background, no scene, no floor, no chair or post, no cast background shadow, no text, no labels, no border, no duplicate characters, no sprite sheet. Fully clothed non-graphic cartoon game asset, no injury, no gore. Do not change into realistic adult proportions.
